findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed a bag of guacamole to be stored in a container of cut tomatoes. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper storage of items and tomatoes were discarded. Ensure any TCS item is properly stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Upon arrival, inspector observed staff going through coolers disposing off TCS items held past 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, date marking education was provided and remaining TCS items were pulled and discarded. Ensure all TCS items are properly date marked and pulled after their 7 day date marking maximum.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed multiple food items kept in walk in cooler and freezer to be resting on a pan on floor. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and items were moved to at least 6 inches off floor. Ensure all food items are stored at least 6 inches off of floor.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
(Repeat x2) Observed multiple containers holding various TCS foods to be held past their 7 day maximum. Discussed with PIC, items were pulled and discarded. Ensure containers are properly date marked and that staff are checking the dates frequently. 

3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed multiple knives being stored on faucet of covered sink. Discussed with PIC, knives were washed and stored on magnetic strip on wall. Ensure knives are being stored in a way to prevent contamination. 

3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
REPEAT: Observed multiple containers holding various meats, homemade sauces, vegetables, and fruit to be held past their 7 day maximum holding. Multiple containers were also thrown out due to no label being present. Discussed with PIC and items were discarded. Ensure containers are properly date marked and that staff are checking the dates frequently.
